question: Who are to be known here as sakalas?
premises: Persons carry massed malas mixed with the māyā-karma upsurge.
inference: Earth-climbing souls with māyā-karma-mixed malas are the sakalas.
uncertainties: Exact force of climbing-upon left open between ascent and station.
plain_english: Here the persons, whose massed malas mix with the upsurge of māyā and karma, climbing upon earth, are to be known as sakalas.
